title: Bobby Ray Inman acknowledges the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office

tellings.quote: he mentioned the national under underwater or undersea reconnaissance office neuro uh and so he he basically acknowledged it was a real thing. In all my years in the Navy as as the O head oceanographer and knowing having access to undersea classified programs, I've never even heard of that organization.

plain: A retired Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, who was once the Navy's head oceanographer, says he heard via a researcher named Sam Gerbus that a man named Bobby Ray Inman had spoken of a National Underwater Reconnaissance Office, a body watching what happens under the sea. Gallaudet says Inman basically confirmed it was real, yet in all his years with access to secret undersea programs he had never heard of it. If true, it would mean a hidden office exists to watch the oceans.
